role.title: AI Engineer, Agent Analytics & Optimization
role.requirements:
US Foster City / Bay Area preferred (California OK). PRIORITY HIRE — production AI Engineer who has shipped agent flows / agent systems / agent observability. NOT Product Builder, NOT research, NOT prompt-engineering-only.

Core job: build systems so AI agents can understand, query, and act on Conviva behavioral data — MCP servers, agentic workflows, AI connectors. Own build + runtime at scale.

PEDIGREE (Yan bar — critical, GitHub rarely has this):
School pedigree is required for outreach priority: MIT / Stanford / CMU / Berkeley / UCLA / Cornell / UIUC / Michigan / Duke (or equivalent evidence in bio/company/education text).
If NO top-school evidence in the profile → score CAP at 60, set school_unverified=true, and flag for manual LinkedIn school verification. Do NOT reject solely for missing school — GitHub often omits it.

LOCATION:
Bay Area / California / US remote preferred. Profiles clearly in Nigeria / India / other non-US locations should be filtered or scored ≤30. MCP+LangGraph alone must NOT push a non-US or school-unverified candidate into the 70+ band.

SOURCING THESIS (why GitHub contributor mining is extremely high-value):
Each production LLM-obs / eval tool ≈ one public repo; contributors to those repos are the people Yan wants. Prefer bios/READMEs mentioning online evaluation, LLM-as-judge in production, gen_ai.* spans.

Market scarcity (score accordingly):
- EXTREMELY SCARCE (top 37% — prioritize): online evals, LLM-as-judge in production, OpenTelemetry gen_ai.* spans, OTel GenAI semantic conventions
- SCARCE (top 52%): RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith evals, offline eval rigor
- COMMON: LangGraph, agent tracing, MCP, Langfuse usage
- TOO BROAD (ignore as primary signal): LLM, AI, ChatGPT
- SKIP: 29% with no eval practice at all

Must have (3–7+ yrs SWE):
- Python backend services shipped end-to-end; fullstack a plus
- LLM-powered agents IN PRODUCTION with concrete failure/fix stories (agent flow / agent system)
- MCP servers or equivalent tool-use / AI connector integrations
- Agentic patterns: tool use, structured outputs, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop
- Evals (prefer online + offline) + observability/tracing (Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, Helicone, Weave, OpenTelemetry, or homegrown)
- Cloud (GCP/AWS), containers, async Python

Bonus: LangGraph, Anthropic SDK, Pydantic-AI, CrewAI; digital experience analytics / APM; published OSS on obs/eval stack.

Score HIGH (80+) only when: top-school evidence OR already flagged for LinkedIn verify AND production agent-obs/eval stack + US/Bay Area location.
Score LOW / DISQUALIFY: pure PM; tutorial/student/bootcamp; agents only in demos; no eval/obs evidence; research-only without shipping; non-US location with no US intent.
role.scoring_notes: School pedigree is critical: MIT/Stanford/CMU/Berkeley/UCLA/Cornell/UIUC/Michigan/Duke required for 70+ scores. Without top school evidence in bio/profile text, cap score at 60 and flag school_unverified=true (manual LinkedIn verification). Bay Area / California / US location preferred — Nigeria/India/non-US self-reported locations cap at 30 (hard filter should already drop clear Nigeria/India). MCP + LangGraph alone are COMMON signals — never score 70+ on stack fingerprints without school OR strong production eval/obs evidence plus US location.
